jobs.description: Register the served cadastral edition's regions in silver.parcel_registry (root ADR-0243; scripts/ops/parcel-registry-cycle.sh): ask which sido prefixes of the edition the registry holds nothing for, smallest first, and bootstrap them one region at a time, starting no new region after 100 minutes so the run ends inside the unit's limit; the next run takes the rest (`unchanged` once every region is registered). Carrying ids across a new edition (advance) reads silver.parcel_lineage, which lineage_stewardship derives, and is a separate change. Daily; it holds every spark slot (the largest region needs the 20g Spark).
jobs.disabled_reason: New (root ADR-0243). Off until its first supervised run on the data host (runbook parcel-registry.md) has registered the first regions within the unit's 150-minute limit and its time and memory per region are recorded; switching it on is a separate deploy step (ADR-0122 §4).

assets.title: 필지 ID 원장
assets.description: 필지마다 바뀌지 않는 parcel_id 가 언제부터 언제까지 어떤 PNU 였는지를 쌓는다. 합병·분할은 새 ID, 번호만 바뀌면 같은 ID(루트 ADR-0113).
